name: menu
title: Menu
description: A hamburger icon that smoothly morphs into an X, with the middle line collapsing.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. When omitted the icon manages its own state.

props.name: onToggle
props.description: Called with the next open state whenever the icon is toggled.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the toggle button.

accessibility: Renders as a button with role="button", aria-expanded reflecting the open state, and an accessible label. Toggles on Enter and Space.
touch: Hover scale is gated behind a (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) check. Tapping toggles the morph directly with spring press feedback.
reducedMotion: The morph duration drops to 150ms so the state change stays perceivable without the full animation.
